description: Source-traced unit catalog for SDS calculations, covering SI/UCUM atoms, common imperial and US customary units, sustainability CO2e scales, currency amount scales, and non-convertible reporting-unit semantics.

mass.description: Mass and weight units (SI plus common imperial/customary references).

energy.description: Energy units (joules, watt-hours, thermal units, and industry references).

volume.description: Volume units (metric plus US customary and imperial liquid/solid references).

area.description: Area units (SI plus common land and building references).

length.description: Length units (SI scales plus imperial/customary and nautical references).

time.description: Time units used in reporting, rates, and sustainability calculations.

percentage.description: Percentage-style normalized ratios and concentration units.

m3_per_million_currency_revenue.name: cubic_meter_per_million_currency_revenue
aliases: m3 per million EUR net revenue

kg CO2e/m2/year.name: kilogram_co2e_per_square_meter_year
aliases: kg CO2e per m2 per year
kg CO2e per square meter per year
kg CO2e per square metre per year

kg CO2e/asset type/year.name: kilogram_co2e_per_asset_type_year
aliases: kg CO2e per asset type per year

kg CO2e/building or asset type/year.name: kilogram_co2e_per_building_or_asset_type_year
aliases: kg CO2e per building or asset type per year

kg CO2e/reported product quantity unit.name: kilogram_co2e_per_reported_product_quantity_unit
aliases: kg CO2e per reported product quantity unit

kg CO2e/reported energy quantity unit.name: kilogram_co2e_per_reported_energy_quantity_unit
aliases: kg CO2e per reported energy quantity unit

power.description: Power units for electrical, thermal, and mechanical power.

pressure.description: Pressure units used in industrial, HVAC, and process reporting.

currency.description: Dimensionless monetary amount scale atoms. FX rates are handled by the FX engine, not by unit factors.

count.description: Sustainability count labels normalized for catalog lookup; population semantics stay in dimensions and formulas.

semantic.description: Non-convertible reporting placeholders and data-value markers used for catalog lookup and UI policy.

ucum.name: Unified Code for Units of Measure

sds.name: SDS canonical sustainability scales and semantic units
